_comment: What this repo vendors from the devcontainer-sandbox template, and where to pull it from. scripts/sync-from-template.sh reads this; .github/workflows/template-sync.yml runs it on a schedule and opens a PR whenever a vendored copy drifts from the canonical upstream. Two things are synced: shared Claude Code skills (into .claude/skills/) and shared standards docs (into standards/). The repo's own skills — listed in "own_skills" — are never touched. To carry another shared skill, add its directory name to "shared_skills"; to carry another shared doc, add a {src,dest} pair to "shared_docs".
